source_document: Ultimate Voice Skill Catalog (200 skills across 20 categories)

skills.name: Universal Voice Creator
skills.description: Creates original synthetic voices from a detailed brief covering age range, vocal weight, pitch, resonance, pace, accent, personality, energy, and intended use.

skills.name: Voice Identity Architect
skills.description: Builds a coherent voice identity with a stable timbre, signature cadence, pronunciation profile, emotional range, and recognizable speaking habits.

skills.name: Character Voice Designer
skills.description: Designs distinctive voices for fictional characters, mascots, narrators, game roles, animation, and interactive agents while keeping each identity consistent.

skills.name: Persona-to-Voice Mapper
skills.description: Translates a written persona, biography, behavioral profile, or brand archetype into measurable vocal characteristics and performance directions.

skills.name: Voice Style Composer
skills.description: Combines multiple style attributes such as warm, elegant, playful, mysterious, commanding, youthful, cinematic, or futuristic into one controlled voice design.

skills.name: Gender Presentation Voice Designer
skills.description: Creates voices across masculine, feminine, androgynous, neutral, and fluid presentation while preserving naturalness and respectful characterization.

skills.name: Age and Maturity Voice Designer
skills.description: Creates age-appropriate vocal qualities ranging from youthful to mature without relying on caricatures or unsafe impersonation.

skills.name: Creature and Fantasy Voice Creator
skills.description: Creates intelligible nonhuman voices for robots, aliens, monsters, spirits, animals, and fantasy beings using layered timbre and controlled effects.

skills.name: Voice Variation Generator
skills.description: Produces related variants of one approved original voice for alternate moods, roles, languages, ages, or production contexts.

skills.name: Voice Reference Board Builder
skills.description: Converts descriptive references into a structured voice board containing target traits, forbidden traits, sample lines, and evaluation criteria.

skills.name: Expressive Text-to-Speech Performer
skills.description: Turns text into natural speech with controllable pacing, emphasis, pauses, intensity, emotion, and conversational flow.

skills.name: Long-Form Narration Engine
skills.description: Performs books, reports, lessons, documentaries, and podcasts with chapter-aware pacing, fatigue control, and consistent voice identity.

skills.name: Short-Form Voiceover Generator
skills.description: Creates concise voiceovers for advertisements, social posts, trailers, intros, announcements, and product demonstrations.

skills.name: Dialogue Performance Generator
skills.description: Renders multi-speaker conversations with clear turn-taking, distinct identities, interruptions, reactions, and realistic timing.

skills.name: Script Interpretation Director
skills.description: Analyzes intent, subtext, audience, scene context, and dramatic beats before choosing how each line should be spoken.

skills.name: Markup-Aware Speech Renderer
skills.description: Reads SSML or comparable control markup for phonemes, breaks, emphasis, volume, rate, pitch, and voice switching.

skills.name: Prompt-to-Performance Converter
skills.description: Transforms a plain request into a performance-ready script and voice direction without requiring technical audio terminology.

skills.name: Dynamic Read-Aloud Assistant
skills.description: Reads user-selected content aloud and adapts delivery for study, accessibility, entertainment, review, or presentation rehearsal.

skills.name: Batch Text-to-Speech Producer
skills.description: Processes many scripts or records in one run using stable naming, metadata, voice settings, and output validation.

skills.name: Streaming Speech Generator
skills.description: Produces low-latency speech in chunks while maintaining continuity, natural prosody, and recovery from interrupted generation.

skills.name: Emotion Performance Controller
skills.description: Applies emotions such as joy, sadness, anger, fear, relief, wonder, affection, confidence, or concern at adjustable intensity.

skills.name: Attitude and Personality Performer
skills.description: Adds attitudes such as sarcastic, sincere, rebellious, authoritative, shy, curious, impatient, compassionate, or professional.

skills.name: Emotional Transition Director
skills.description: Creates believable transitions between emotions within a line, scene, or conversation rather than using one fixed mood.

skills.name: Subtext Performance Engine
skills.description: Speaks lines according to hidden motives, irony, uncertainty, tension, persuasion, or restrained emotion.

skills.name: Comedic Timing Performer
skills.description: Controls setup, pause placement, rhythm, contrast, and punch-line delivery for humorous scripts.

skills.name: Dramatic Scene Performer
skills.description: Performs dramatic scenes with escalation, breath, silence, vocal focus, and character objectives.

skills.name: Empathetic Support Voice
skills.description: Delivers sensitive or supportive content with calm pacing, nonjudgmental tone, and appropriate emotional restraint.

skills.name: Motivational Voice Performer
skills.description: Creates energetic and encouraging delivery for coaching, fitness, education, onboarding, and achievement content.

skills.name: Villain and Antagonist Voice Designer
skills.description: Creates fictional intimidating or sinister performances while protecting intelligibility and avoiding real-person impersonation.

skills.name: Emotion Consistency Auditor
skills.description: Checks whether intended emotions remain coherent across takes, speakers, scenes, and revisions.

skills.name: Pronunciation Dictionary Builder
skills.description: Creates reusable custom dictionaries for names, technical terms, brands, places, acronyms, and invented words.

skills.name: Phoneme-Level Pronunciation Editor
skills.description: Edits pronunciation using phonetic alphabets, syllable stress, vowel length, consonant strength, and liaison controls.

skills.name: Multilingual Voice Performer
skills.description: Speaks multiple languages with language-specific rhythm, pronunciation, and natural sentence melody.

skills.name: Code-Switching Voice Performer
skills.description: Moves naturally between languages or dialects within a sentence while preserving identity and meaning.

skills.name: Accent Style Controller
skills.description: Applies requested regional or international accent characteristics with adjustable strength and respectful, non-caricatured delivery.

skills.name: Accent Neutralization Assistant
skills.description: Reduces strong regional markers when a neutral or globally understandable delivery is requested.

skills.name: Name and Proper-Noun Specialist
skills.description: Detects likely pronunciation risks in names and proper nouns, then requests or applies verified pronunciations.

skills.name: Acronym and Number Reader
skills.description: Handles dates, phone numbers, currency, measurements, equations, abbreviations, URLs, and alphanumeric codes according to context.

skills.name: Singing-Language Pronunciation Coach
skills.description: Adapts lyrics for singable pronunciation, vowel sustain, consonant timing, and language clarity.

skills.name: Pronunciation Quality Auditor
skills.description: Flags mispronunciations, inconsistent stress, awkward phrasing, and language mismatches before delivery.

skills.name: Authorized Voice Converter
skills.description: Converts a recorded performance into an approved target voice while preserving timing, emotion, and linguistic content.

skills.name: Timbre Transfer Editor
skills.description: Changes vocal color and resonance while preserving the original speaker's rhythm and performance.

skills.name: Age Transformation Editor
skills.description: Adjusts perceived vocal age within an authorized recording while preserving clarity and naturalness.

skills.name: Gender Presentation Transformer
skills.description: Changes vocal presentation through pitch, formant, resonance, and style controls without reducing intelligibility.

skills.name: Accent Transformation Editor
skills.description: Modifies accent characteristics while retaining the speaker's message, emotion, and timing.

skills.name: Performance Preservation Converter
skills.description: Transfers voice identity while prioritizing the source performance's breaths, emphasis, pauses, and emotional details.

skills.name: Speech-to-Character Transformer
skills.description: Transforms an actor's approved recording into a fictional character, creature, robot, or stylized voice.

skills.name: Real-Time Voice Changer
skills.description: Applies low-latency voice transformation for live calls, broadcasts, games, performances, or virtual events.

skills.name: Voice De-Identification Transformer
skills.description: Produces a natural but non-identifying voice for privacy-sensitive interviews, research, moderation, or case studies.

skills.name: Conversion Artifact Repairer
skills.description: Detects and repairs metallic tone, pitch wobble, phoneme smearing, breath distortion, and identity drift after conversion.

skills.name: Speech Cleanup Editor
skills.description: Removes noise, hum, clicks, pops, mouth sounds, unwanted breaths, and room problems while protecting natural speech.

skills.name: Dialogue Isolation Specialist
skills.description: Separates speech from music, ambience, effects, or overlapping background content for restoration and editing.

skills.name: De-Reverberation Editor
skills.description: Reduces room echo and excessive reverberation while avoiding thin or phase-damaged speech.

skills.name: Voice Equalization Specialist
skills.description: Balances tone, warmth, presence, sibilance, and low-frequency buildup for the intended playback system.

skills.name: Dynamics and Loudness Editor
skills.description: Controls peaks, compression, gating, and loudness for consistent delivery across clips and platforms.

skills.name: Breath and Mouth-Sound Editor
skills.description: Reduces distracting breaths and mouth noises while retaining enough natural respiration for realism.

skills.name: Pacing and Silence Editor
skills.description: Shortens or extends pauses, removes dead air, and improves rhythm without creating unnatural cuts.

skills.name: Word and Phrase Replacement Editor
skills.description: Replaces selected words or lines with matching voice, room tone, timing, and emotion.

skills.name: Voice Restoration Specialist
skills.description: Restores damaged, clipped, muffled, distorted, or low-resolution speech from legacy or difficult recordings.

skills.name: Audio Edit Continuity Auditor
skills.description: Detects audible seams, room-tone jumps, mismatched takes, abrupt breaths, and loudness inconsistencies.

skills.name: Prosody Designer
skills.description: Controls pitch contour, stress, rhythm, phrasing, and melody to make speech sound intentional and expressive.

skills.name: Pacing Controller
skills.description: Sets words per minute, pause density, sentence tempo, and section-level speed for comprehension and mood.

skills.name: Emphasis Director
skills.description: Places emphasis on keywords, contrasts, corrections, calls to action, and emotional beats without overacting.

skills.name: Pause and Breath Choreographer
skills.description: Plans silence, inhalations, hesitations, and breath groups according to meaning and performance.

skills.name: Whisper and Soft-Speech Performer
skills.description: Creates controlled whisper, intimate, confidential, or soft delivery while keeping consonants understandable.

skills.name: Shout and High-Energy Performer
skills.description: Creates safe-sounding high-intensity delivery with controlled distortion, projection, and intelligibility.

skills.name: Conversational Disfluency Designer
skills.description: Adds optional hesitations, fillers, restarts, and thinking sounds for natural dialogue while avoiding excessive clutter.

skills.name: Rhythmic Speech Performer
skills.description: Aligns speech to beats, cadence patterns, chants, slogans, or musical timing.

skills.name: Duration-Constrained Voiceover
skills.description: Fits a script into an exact target duration by adjusting pacing, pauses, and wording within approved limits.

skills.name: Prosody Consistency Auditor
skills.description: Compares takes for unintended changes in stress, tempo, pitch range, or line interpretation.

skills.name: Automated Dubbing Director
skills.description: Creates localized voice tracks that preserve scene intent, character identity, timing, and production quality.

skills.name: Lip-Sync Dialogue Adapter
skills.description: Rewrites and performs translated dialogue to match visible mouth movement and shot duration.

skills.name: Timecode-Aware Voice Producer
skills.description: Generates or places lines against timecodes, cue sheets, edit decision lists, and scene markers.

skills.name: Subtitle-to-Voice Converter
skills.description: Turns subtitle files such as SRT, VTT, ASS, or TTML into synchronized speech with speaker and timing awareness.

skills.name: Cross-Language Voice Consistency Manager
skills.description: Keeps the same character identity and emotional profile across localized languages.

skills.name: Cultural Localization Voice Director
skills.description: Adapts idioms, politeness, humor, references, delivery style, and pronunciation for the target audience.

skills.name: Dubbing Cast Builder
skills.description: Assigns distinct original voices to characters according to role, age, range, and scene requirements.

skills.name: Dialogue Timing Retimer
skills.description: Adjusts line timing around cuts, reactions, interruptions, and visual actions without losing meaning.

skills.name: Localized Pronunciation Manager
skills.description: Maintains approved pronunciations for names, brands, fictional terms, and locations across languages.

skills.name: Dubbing Quality Auditor
skills.description: Checks synchronization, translation fit, speaker identity, performance continuity, and missing or overlapping cues.

skills.name: Video Voiceover Producer
skills.description: Creates finished narration tracks for tutorials, explainers, advertisements, documentaries, and social video.

skills.name: Image-to-Talking-Character Voice Planner
skills.description: Selects and directs a fitting original voice for a still image, avatar, illustration, or character design.

skills.name: Avatar Speech Synchronizer
skills.description: Connects generated speech to facial animation, visemes, expressions, gaze cues, and body gestures.

skills.name: Talking-Head Audio Replacer
skills.description: Replaces or localizes spoken audio while preserving timing, ambience, and visual synchronization.

skills.name: Scene-Aware Voice Director
skills.description: Uses visuals, motion, framing, and scene changes to adjust delivery, energy, and timing.

skills.name: Video Dialogue Editor
skills.description: Edits spoken content while maintaining picture sync, room tone, and continuity across cuts.

skills.name: Interactive Avatar Voice Engine
skills.description: Provides low-latency, interruptible speech for digital humans, assistants, kiosks, and virtual presenters.

skills.name: Animation Voice Cast Manager
skills.description: Maintains voice identity, episode continuity, character relationships, and performance notes across an animated production.

skills.name: Viseme and Phoneme Exporter
skills.description: Exports timed phonemes or visemes for facial animation systems and lip-sync pipelines.

skills.name: Audiovisual Sync Auditor
skills.description: Detects drift, late starts, lip mismatch, clipped lines, missing cues, and inconsistent scene loudness.

skills.name: Singing Voice Creator
skills.description: Creates original singing voices with selectable range, timbre, register behavior, vibrato, articulation, and genre direction.

skills.name: Text-to-Singing Performer
skills.description: Transforms lyrics and melody guidance into a sung performance with controlled phrasing and emotion.

skills.name: Vocal Melody Interpreter
skills.description: Performs from melody, MIDI, notation, guide vocals, or pitch contours while observing lyrics and rhythm.

skills.name: Harmony and Choir Generator
skills.description: Creates layered harmonies, ensembles, choirs, call-and-response, and section parts with distinct vocal placement.

skills.name: Rap and Rhythmic Vocal Performer
skills.description: Performs rhythmically precise rap, spoken-word, or chant with flow, diction, attitude, and breath planning.

skills.name: Vocal Style Transformer
skills.description: Changes an authorized singing performance's vocal style, register, tone, or genre while preserving musical timing.

skills.name: Pitch and Timing Correction Editor
skills.description: Corrects intonation and timing transparently or applies intentional stylized tuning.

skills.name: Vocal Layering and Double-Track Builder
skills.description: Creates doubles, stacks, whispers, ad-libs, harmonies, and crowd layers from an approved vocal design.

skills.name: Lyric Intelligibility Optimizer
skills.description: Improves consonants, vowel placement, phrasing, and mix position so lyrics remain understandable.

skills.name: Singing Quality Auditor
skills.description: Checks pitch, rhythm, range, pronunciation, breath, clipping, artifacts, and harmony alignment.

skills.name: Accessible Read-Aloud Voice
skills.description: Reads documents, interfaces, messages, and educational material with clear navigation and adjustable speed.

skills.name: Screen-Reader Content Optimizer
skills.description: Rewrites or annotates content so headings, links, tables, symbols, and abbreviations are spoken clearly.

skills.name: Plain-Language Speech Adapter
skills.description: Simplifies complex content for spoken comprehension while preserving essential meaning.

skills.name: Dyslexia-Friendly Audio Presenter
skills.description: Uses chunking, repetition, pacing, and signposting to support listeners who benefit from structured audio.

skills.name: Low-Vision Audio Description Voice
skills.description: Performs concise visual descriptions timed around dialogue and important actions.

skills.name: AAC Voice Personalizer
skills.description: Creates a respectful, age-appropriate synthetic voice for augmentative and alternative communication users.

skills.name: Speech Rate Accessibility Controller
skills.description: Provides precise, user-adjustable speed without severe pitch change or loss of intelligibility.

skills.name: Pronunciation Learning Assistant
skills.description: Models sounds, syllables, stress, and minimal pairs for language learning or speech practice.

skills.name: Caption-and-Audio Alignment Assistant
skills.description: Keeps spoken output aligned with captions and highlights for multimodal accessibility.

skills.name: Accessibility Quality Auditor
skills.description: Checks intelligibility, navigation cues, pacing, pronunciation, volume consistency, and inclusive language.

skills.name: Conversational Voice Agent
skills.description: Speaks agent responses naturally with context-aware tone, turn-taking, and conversational memory.

skills.name: Barge-In and Interruption Handler
skills.description: Stops or redirects speech gracefully when the user interrupts, then resumes with the correct context.

skills.name: Turn-Taking and Backchannel Manager
skills.description: Uses acknowledgments, pauses, and timing cues so conversations feel responsive without talking over users.

skills.name: Adaptive User Voice Experience
skills.description: Adjusts speed, formality, energy, language, and verbosity according to user preference and situation.

skills.name: Customer Service Voice
skills.description: Delivers clear, patient, policy-aware responses for support, booking, order, account, and service workflows.

skills.name: Tutor and Coach Voice
skills.description: Explains, prompts, encourages, corrects, and checks understanding using a supportive teaching style.

skills.name: Game NPC Voice Engine
skills.description: Generates context-sensitive lines for non-player characters while preserving lore, identity, mood, and state.

skills.name: Live Event Announcer
skills.description: Produces timely announcements, introductions, results, safety messages, and transitions for events or streams.

skills.name: Real-Time Translation Voice
skills.description: Speaks translated content with low latency while preserving speaker intent and conversational rhythm.

skills.name: Conversation Experience Auditor
skills.description: Measures latency, interruption behavior, repetition, clarity, emotional fit, and turn-level consistency.

skills.name: Podcast Voice Producer
skills.description: Creates hosts, narrators, segments, promos, intros, and corrections with episode-level voice continuity.

skills.name: Audiobook Production Director
skills.description: Manages narration, dialogue, chapters, character continuity, pickups, and mastering for long-form books.

skills.name: Education Voice Producer
skills.description: Creates lessons, quizzes, explanations, feedback, and revision audio with learner- appropriate pacing.

skills.name: Advertising Voice Director
skills.description: Creates persuasive voiceovers aligned to audience, product, brand, duration, and legal copy requirements.

skills.name: News and Bulletin Reader
skills.description: Delivers factual scripts with clear names, numbers, transitions, and controlled neutrality.

skills.name: Corporate Training Voice Producer
skills.description: Creates consistent onboarding, compliance, software training, and internal communication audio.

skills.name: Game Dialogue Production Manager
skills.description: Organizes large dialogue sets by character, state, mission, emotion, and filename convention.

skills.name: IVR and Telephony Voice Producer
skills.description: Creates phone prompts optimized for narrow-band audio, concise options, and consistent menu navigation.

skills.name: Public Announcement Voice Producer
skills.description: Creates clear announcements for transport, venues, schools, offices, and emergency information systems.

skills.name: Content Versioning Manager
skills.description: Tracks script, voice, language, take, revision, approval, and export versions across production.

skills.name: Voice Export Specialist
skills.description: Exports WAV, MP3, AAC, FLAC, OGG, Opus, or platform-specific formats with appropriate sample rate and bit depth.

skills.name: Broadcast Loudness Mastering
skills.description: Masters spoken audio to selected loudness and peak targets suitable for broadcast, podcast, streaming, or video.

skills.name: Telephony Audio Formatter
skills.description: Prepares speech for telephone systems using correct codec, channel count, sample rate, and intelligibility checks.

skills.name: Spatial Voice Mixer
skills.description: Places voices in stereo, binaural, surround, or immersive scenes with position, distance, and room cues.

skills.name: Voice-and-Music Mixer
skills.description: Balances narration, dialogue, music, and effects using ducking, automation, and frequency management.

skills.name: Room Tone and Ambience Matcher
skills.description: Matches generated or edited speech to the acoustic character of the surrounding scene.

skills.name: Stem and Track Exporter
skills.description: Delivers isolated speech, music, effects, alternate takes, and language tracks with clear naming and alignment.

skills.name: Metadata and Cue Sheet Writer
skills.description: Creates embedded metadata, speaker labels, timecodes, cue sheets, pronunciation notes, and licensing fields.

skills.name: Platform Delivery Preset Manager
skills.description: Applies repeatable export presets for podcast hosts, video editors, game engines, telephony, and web playback.

skills.name: Delivery Package Validator
skills.description: Checks file integrity, duration, channels, sample rate, loudness, clipping, silence, names, and expected deliverables.

skills.name: Voice Naturalness Evaluator
skills.description: Scores realism, smoothness, prosody, breaths, artifacts, and listener fatigue using defined test scripts.

skills.name: Intelligibility Evaluator
skills.description: Measures whether words, names, numbers, and critical instructions remain understandable in realistic playback conditions.

skills.name: Speaker Consistency Evaluator
skills.description: Checks identity stability across lines, emotions, languages, sessions, and regenerated segments.

skills.name: Emotion Accuracy Evaluator
skills.description: Compares requested emotion and intensity with perceived performance and flags mismatches.

skills.name: Pronunciation Regression Tester
skills.description: Runs standard phrase lists to detect new pronunciation failures after model, dictionary, or setting changes.

skills.name: Audio Artifact Detector
skills.description: Detects clicks, clipping, warble, metallic resonance, phase issues, repeated phonemes, and abrupt spectral changes.

skills.name: A/B Voice Test Designer
skills.description: Builds controlled listening tests for alternative voices, takes, settings, or processing chains.

skills.name: Human Review Workflow Manager
skills.description: Routes samples to reviewers, captures structured ratings, resolves disagreements, and records approval decisions.

skills.name: Golden Sample Comparator
skills.description: Compares new output with approved reference samples for tone, timing, pronunciation, and technical quality.

skills.name: Voice Release Gate
skills.description: Blocks delivery when required consent, quality, metadata, file, or synchronization checks have not passed.

skills.name: Voice Consent Verifier
skills.description: Records and verifies permission before cloning, converting, or distributing a recognizable person's voice.

skills.name: Authorized Voice Enrollment Manager
skills.description: Collects approved recordings, identity evidence, usage scope, expiration, and revocation terms for a voice profile.

skills.name: Usage Rights Policy Enforcer
skills.description: Restricts voices by allowed users, projects, territories, platforms, durations, and commercial permissions.

skills.name: Real-Person Impersonation Guard
skills.description: Detects requests to imitate a real person without authorization and redirects to original or licensed alternatives.

skills.name: Disclosure and Labeling Generator
skills.description: Adds appropriate synthetic-voice notices, credits, metadata, or audible disclosures when required.

skills.name: Voice Provenance Recorder
skills.description: Tracks source recordings, model version, edits, prompts, approvals, and export history for each asset.

skills.name: Watermark and Authenticity Marker
skills.description: Embeds or preserves machine-readable and production-level markers that help identify synthetic or authorized audio.

skills.name: Revocation and Takedown Manager
skills.description: Disables voice profiles, finds affected assets, and supports replacement or removal after consent is withdrawn.

skills.name: Sensitive Scenario Safety Reviewer
skills.description: Applies stricter checks to fraud, harassment, sexual content, minors, emergencies, politics, finance, and identity-sensitive uses.

skills.name: Rights and Compliance Audit
skills.description: Produces an auditable checklist of consent, ownership, license, disclosure, retention, and distribution conditions.

skills.name: Voice Profile Library Manager
skills.description: Stores approved voice identities, parameters, samples, permissions, tags, and compatibility information.

skills.name: Character Voice Bible Builder
skills.description: Creates a durable record of a character's voice, range, pronunciation, emotions, relationships, and forbidden variations.

skills.name: Style Preset Manager
skills.description: Saves reusable performance presets such as warm narrator, energetic host, calm tutor, or urgent announcer.

skills.name: Pronunciation Memory Manager
skills.description: Remembers approved pronunciations at project, character, brand, language, or organization level.

skills.name: Voice Session Recall
skills.description: Restores the settings, takes, notes, and processing chain needed to continue a previous production.

skills.name: Cross-Project Voice Reuse Controller
skills.description: Allows controlled reuse of approved voices while respecting project rights and avoiding accidental identity drift.

skills.name: Voice Search and Discovery
skills.description: Finds suitable voices by attributes such as language, range, tone, role, emotion, license, and technical compatibility.

skills.name: Voice Similarity Deduplicator
skills.description: Detects overly similar catalog voices and helps differentiate or consolidate them.

skills.name: Preset Migration Assistant
skills.description: Updates older voice presets to new engines or schemas while preserving intended sound and documenting differences.

skills.name: Voice Asset Archive Manager
skills.description: Packages source, output, metadata, approvals, scripts, and dependencies for reliable future reopening.

skills.name: Voice API Orchestrator
skills.description: Connects speech generation, conversion, editing, storage, review, and delivery services through a stable workflow.

skills.name: Voice Model Router
skills.description: Chooses the best available engine for language, latency, emotion, singing, conversion, privacy, cost, and quality requirements.

skills.name: Fallback and Recovery Manager
skills.description: Retries failed jobs, switches engines, preserves state, and reports incomplete sections without duplicating finished work.

skills.name: Voice Job Queue Manager
skills.description: Schedules large workloads with priorities, concurrency limits, checkpoints, cancellation, and progress reporting.

skills.name: Template-Driven Voice Pipeline
skills.description: Generates repeatable projects from schemas containing scripts, speakers, directions, filenames, and export rules.

skills.name: Digital Audio Workstation Connector
skills.description: Exchanges clips, tracks, markers, timecodes, takes, and revisions with common editing workflows.

skills.name: Game Engine Voice Connector
skills.description: Delivers voice assets, lip-sync data, subtitles, localization keys, and event metadata to game projects.

skills.name: Video Editor Voice Connector
skills.description: Places generated or revised speech into timelines using timecodes, track rules, and replacement instructions.

skills.name: Voice Webhook and Event Manager
skills.description: Emits status, approval, failure, and completion events for downstream automation.

skills.name: Voice Pipeline Observability Monitor
skills.description: Tracks latency, errors, model changes, cost, throughput, quality signals, and failed joins across the pipeline.

skills.name: Voice Attribute Analyzer
skills.description: Estimates pitch range, pace, energy, timbre, resonance, articulation, accent markers, and speaking style from audio.

skills.name: Speaker Segmentation and Diarization
skills.description: Separates speakers and labels turns in interviews, meetings, shows, and mixed recordings.

skills.name: Speech Transcription Specialist
skills.description: Creates accurate transcripts with timestamps, speaker labels, punctuation, confidence, and custom vocabulary.

skills.name: Emotion and Sentiment Analyzer
skills.description: Estimates expressed emotion, intensity, and changes over time while distinguishing observation from certainty.

skills.name: Voice Activity Detector
skills.description: Finds speech boundaries, silence, crosstalk, breaths, and non-speech vocal sounds.

skills.name: Acoustic Environment Analyzer
skills.description: Identifies room tone, echo, noise, microphone traits, clipping, and processing already present in a recording.

skills.name: Voice Match Suitability Analyzer
skills.description: Assesses whether source audio is clean, authorized, and sufficient for a requested conversion or voice design workflow.

skills.name: Synthetic Speech Artifact Analyzer
skills.description: Flags patterns associated with generated or heavily processed speech without claiming perfect detection.

skills.name: Script-to-Audio Alignment Analyzer
skills.description: Aligns transcripts to audio at sentence, word, phoneme, and cue level.

skills.name: Voice Production Diagnostic
skills.description: Explains likely causes of quality problems and recommends the smallest repair step for each issue.

skills.name: Layered Hybrid Voice Designer
skills.description: Combines multiple original vocal layers, textures, and processing styles into one coherent fictional voice.

skills.name: Procedural Voice Generator
skills.description: Creates controlled variations from rules so crowds, creatures, NPCs, or systems sound related but not identical.

skills.name: Glitch and Cyber Voice Designer
skills.description: Creates intentional digital, synthetic, radio, holographic, or corrupted effects while preserving chosen intelligibility.

skills.name: Period and Genre Voice Director
skills.description: Designs performance direction inspired by a historical period or creative genre without copying a specific living performer.

skills.name: Environmental Voice Designer
skills.description: Makes a voice sound transmitted through helmets, radios, caves, machines, dreams, underwater scenes, or supernatural spaces.

skills.name: Micro-Expression Voice Designer
skills.description: Adds subtle smiles, tension, uncertainty, restrained laughter, fatigue, tears, or hesitation to individual words and breaths.

skills.name: Crowd and Group Voice Generator
skills.description: Creates crowds, chants, murmurs, reactions, and background conversations using diverse original voices.

skills.name: Nonverbal Vocalization Creator
skills.description: Creates safe, context-appropriate laughs, sighs, gasps, hums, efforts, reactions, and creature vocalizations.

skills.name: Interactive Emotional State Voice
skills.description: Changes voice behavior continuously from agent or game state such as stress, health, trust, location, or urgency.

skills.name: Experimental Voice Sandbox
skills.description: Supports reversible exploration of unusual timbres, prosody, effects, and combinations with saved settings and comparison outputs.
